source_snippets.text:
# Create the runtime before data preparation/model loading.
    session = CandidateSession.from_env()
    run_started = time.time()
    global _PREPARATION_DEADLINE
    with open("./candidate_results/run.json", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        admitted_run = json.load(handle)
    runtime_config = admitted_run["runtime_config"]
    # Never substitute the nominal 7200-second cap for the admitted budget.
    _PREPARATION_DEADLINE = (
        float(admitted_run["started_at"])
        + float(runtime_config["candidate_budget_seconds"])
        - float(runtime_config["finalization_reserve_seconds"])
    )
    check_preparation_budget()
